report_comment.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. FLT3 encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase expressed in hematopoietic progenitors. The reported in-frame ETV6::FLT3 fusion joined ETV6 exons 1-6 to FLT3 exons 14-24 in an infant myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia. Gilteritinib induced immunophenotypic and cytogenetic remission in a published infant with ETV6::FLT3; this is case-level off-label evidence, distinct from the FLT3-mutation AML indication.
